title: 8 · Preserved history and amendments
summary: Original model-locked coding diagram is historical; no mandatory Astra/Sol/Terra handoff.
body:
Original model-locked coding diagram is historical; no mandatory Astra/Sol/Terra handoff.

One-page-only fitting and expensive subset selection are superseded by one/two-page content priority.

Original implementation ordering is retained for reference; current checkpoint records control the current task.

Separate block ownership is retained; one coordinated initial call remains the recommendation, not a proven quality result.

User feedback is preserved verbatim, including questions and provisional acceptance; not every recommendation becomes implementation evidence.

children.title: Preserve the former implementation sequence without treating it as current authorization
children.summary: The historical nine-step order was minimal event/stopping controls; complete resolved evidence; placement/selection/project; JD passage preservation; early coherent draft; sequential review/layout/final coverage; evaluator calibration; instrumented Stibo run; McKesson check.

children.title: Preserve provisional feedback and substantive amendments
children.summary: The numbered feedback includes provisional positive reactions rather than unconditional proof of implementation.

children.title: Keep two-page content priority and retire one-page subset optimization
children.summary: The user amendment replaces one-page-only fitting: one, one-and-a-half or two pages are acceptable, with readable fonts/spacing and no stranded employer headings.

evidence_limit: Design/context migration only; source provenance does not certify application or worker-controller implementation.
